title: Grandiose (1982)
problem: It adds 3 at the start of your creatures' turns.
notes: Community claim: The turn counter rises at the start of the turn, not the end. Evidence: bc_CreatureStartOfTurn scr_AnyAllyHasPassive(1982) @0x140b24601 → battleturns @0x140b24649 / 0x140b2467c. Fix sketch: Reword "At the end" to "At the start" (T). Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. The turn counter rises at the start of the turn. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "At the end of your creatures' turns, their turn counter increases by 3". Fix: H: move the +3 battleturns from bc_CreatureStartOfTurn (@0x140b24601) to the end of the turn. vs bugged: neutral (timing). | In-game test: Grandiose holder: its turn counter shows +3 only after its turn ends (check a turn-count trait or the counter before and after the turn); no change at the start of the turn.

release_notes.intended: At the end of your creatures' turns, their turn counter increases by 3 more.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the +3 came at the start of the turn.
release_notes.fix: Now it comes at the end of the turn.
